relationships.subject: rTMS
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared to the CCI group, the rTMS group exhibited reduced TRPV1 expression not only in the PFC (p < 0.05), but also in the spinal cord (p < 0.01)

relationships.subject: TENS
relationships.evidence_quote: whereas TENS alone reduced TRPV1 expression in the spinal cord (p < 0.01)

relationships.subject: rTMS
relationships.evidence_quote: After 4 weeks of rTMS intervention, the levels of IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF-α in the PFC and spinal cord were decreased compared with those in the CCI group.

relationships.subject: TENS
relationships.evidence_quote: only IL-1β showed a significant reduction compared to the CCI group (p < 0.05)

key_findings: rTMS of the PFC outperformed TENS in raising mechanical threshold in CCI rats and lowered IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α and TRPV1 in PFC and spinal cord
TENS reduced spinal TRPV1 and only IL-1β
